elaine_cs: Heads up — PolarisHealth embed usage spiked ~6x Wed→Fri. Health otherwise fine but this will blow out the monthly run rate if it continues. Starting triage here.

jordan_fin: Can you paste the per-day token/embeds numbers so I can re-run the forecast for QBR?

elaine_cs: Sure, raw daily lines from billing:```
2026-03-15, embeds, 12k
2026-03-16, embeds, 14k
2026-03-17, embeds, 76k
2026-03-18, embeds, 68k
2026-03-19, embeds, 74k
```

sam_onboarding: Is this tied to a campaign or a new client-side rollout? Any recent config changes on their end?

elaine_cs: They shipped a v2 search bundle yesterday behind a flag. Kevin, can you confirm if our logs show more prefetches/duplicates? cc @kevin_engineering

kevin_engineering: Confirmed — client prefetch rate jumped. We see ~20% more prefetch requests and some larger batch sizes. Plan: add debounce + reduce batch_size 32→8. ETA for patch: today EOD.

jordan_fin: If this burn holds, month forecast is ~3.5x baseline. For QBR we should propose two asks: 1) short-term credit buffer to cover the spike, 2) engineering enablement + rate caps to avoid recurrence. Thoughts?

sam_onboarding: :thumbsup: Recommend temporary rate limit on the embed route + one-week retainer credits. Also prepare a 1-pager with SDK/flag guidance for the customer's engineers.

elaine_cs: I'll own the enablement checklist and updated spend forecast. billing-bot just sent an alert — dropping it here.

billing-bot: Alert: usage anomaly detected for account PolarisHealth (alert id 98321). Suggested actions: outreach, review recent deploys, consider temporary credit hold. https://billing/internal/alerts/98321

jordan_fin: For the QBR deck: call out root cause = client rollout + prefetch; mitigation = debounce + smaller batch + temp credits. I'll own the budget ask. Elaine — can you add a one-slide delta with impact calc?

elaine_cs: Yes. Will post slide draft by 16:00 PT and tag @sam_onboarding for customer comms draft.

sam_onboarding: Copy — will draft comms and propose an enablement session next Tue.

kevin_engineering: Patch is on canary now. Early telemetry shows ~40% reduction in duplicate calls. Monitoring closely.

elaine_cs: Great — thanks all. Will keep this thread updated as we get numbers. :white_check_mark:
